description.value: Full-service RV resort in the Columbia Valley with included discounted access to Fairmont's natural mineral hot springs pools; blacktop pull-through sites with full hook-ups, resort amenities, and a $10/day resort experience fee on top of site rates.

address.value: 5225 Fairmont Resort Road, Fairmont Hot Springs, V0B 1L1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active RV Resort within the larger Fairmont Hot Springs Resort complex, listing amenities such as electrical hook-ups (30A/50A), sani-dump, free Wi-Fi, an onsite store, and access to natural mineral hot springs pools. Bear-safe garbage bins are explicitly mentioned alongside a strict food-storage policy, confirming animal-safe food storage. Reservation policies (check-in, check-out, reservation holder responsibilities) confirm reservations are accepted. The phone number matches between OSM and the website; the email differs (OSM: resinfo@fairmonthotsprings.com vs website: rvpark@fhsr.com). OSM tags for showers and laundry could not be confirmed from the website content.
concerns: Email discrepancy: OSM lists resinfo@fairmonthotsprings.com but the website shows rvpark@fhsr.com as the RV park contact email
OSM indicates tents are accepted (tents=yes) but the website content focuses exclusively on RV camping; tent-site availability for touring cyclists should be verified
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, full-service campground within a well-known resort complex in the Columbia Valley. A touring cyclist would benefit from the amenities and hot springs access.

wow_evidence: included discounted access to Fairmont's natural mineral hot springs pools
